GOAL_DATE.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: This panel shows how many days are left until the target date for course completion, as well as the set date. If the course is not mandatory, you can edit this date whenever necessary, adjusting your progress according to your availability. The target date is an effective way to stay engaged and ensure you complete all activities within the desired timeframe.
GOAL_DATE.TITLE: DAYS TO TARGET DATE

PROGRESS.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: The progress reflects how much you have advanced in the course relative to the total activities and available content. Each completed activity contributes to increasing your progress percentage. Use this information to monitor your advancement and ensure you are on the right track to complete the course within the estimated time.
PROGRESS.TITLE: YOUR PROGRESS
